chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

When the believer dies, the regions of the earth upon which he used to worship Allah, Mighty and Majestic, weep for him, as does the gate through which his deeds used to ascend, and the place of his prostration.

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُ: the believer, the person characterized by iman
key_terms.بِقَاعُ الْأَرْضِ: the tracts or places of the earth associated with a person’s worship
key_terms.سُجُودِهِ: his prostration, referring to his place of sajdah in worship
key_terms.عَمَلُهُ: his deeds, especially those that rise and are accepted
key_terms.يَعْبُدُ اللَّهَ: worships Allah through devotion and obedience

ai.seo_question: What happens spiritually when a believer dies according to the hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the spiritual أثر of a believer’s worship, showing that the places connected to his devotion bear witness to him and grieve his loss. It highlights the dignity of worship and the lasting significance of sincere salat and sajdah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "When a believer dies, the places on earth where they used to worship Allah (swt), the door through which their deeds would ascend, and their place of prostration weep for them."
